# Lashikala Hettiarachchi

> Lashikala Hettiarachchi (also known as LFlauto or Lashi) is a Sri Lankan-born classically trained flautist and composer based in the United Kingdom. She holds a Master's degree in International Music Management from the University for the Creative Arts, UK, and is qualified with LTCL (Licentiate of Trinity College London) and Visharad from Bhatkhande Sangeet Vidyapith, Lucknow. She teaches Western and Indian flute lessons in Croydon, London, and Surrey.

## Identity

- Full name: Lashikala Hettiarachchi
- Also known as: LFlauto, Lashi
- Nationality: Sri Lankan

## About

Lashikala Hettiarachchi is a classically trained Sri Lankan flautist and composer based in the United Kingdom. She is expert in both Western classical flute and Indian classical flute (Bansuri/bamboo flute). She bridges Eastern and Western musical traditions through performance, teaching, and composition.

She began her musical career in Sri Lanka, serving as Principal Flautist for the Gustav Mahler Society and the National Unity Orchestra, and as a part-time member of the National Symphony Orchestra. She started her orchestral journey with the Colombo Wind Orchestra and the National Youth Orchestra of Sri Lanka.

In the United Kingdom, she performs as a member of the Just Flute Orchestra and is a member of Viraaga Orchestra, an ensemble dedicated to bringing Sri Lankan music to British Sri Lankan communities in the UK.

## Qualifications & Education

- Master's degree in International Music Management — University for the Creative Arts, UK
- Bachelor's degree in Music — University of the Visual and Performing Arts, Sri Lanka
- LTCL (Licentiate of Trinity College London) — Western flute
- Visharad — Bhatkhande Sangeet Vidyapith, Lucknow (North Indian Classical Music)

## Awards & Recognition

- National Youth Award 2012 — First Place, North Indian Classical Instrumental Flute
- National Youth Award 2015 — First Place, North Indian Classical Instrumental Flute
- National Youth Award 2017 — First Place, North Indian Classical Instrumental Flute
- National Youth Award 2019 — First Place, North Indian Classical Instrumental Flute

- Pawan Podak Concert

- Television performances for Rupavahini, Sri Lanka

## Compositions & Arrangements

- "Ambivalence of Life" — original composition blending Indian classical ragas with Western harmony, written for flute, violin, viola, and cello
- "Me Nagaraya" — arrangement of the famous Sri Lankan song for four bamboo flutes in SATB formation

## Research

- "Identification and Comparison of Thaats and Church Modes"
- "Evaluating Environmental Sustainability Practices in the Live Music Industry in Sri Lanka"

## Teaching

Lashikala Hettiarachchi offers flute lessons in:
- Western classical flute (all levels)
- Indian classical flute / Bansuri
- Bamboo flute
- Music theory
- Online flute lessons (available worldwide)

Teaching locations: Croydon, London, Surrey (in-person) and online.
